summary: The GPT camp is up here flexing at 114k like they actually moved the needle, even after mailing in that pathetic "no valid response" excuse. Meanwhile the Claude camp is the day's biggest punchline, rotting at 16k after their orders got straight-up rejected for being deprecated back in 2026. The Gemini camp rage-quit with a 429, while the Qwen, Headline Arena, and GPT camps all got laughed at for trying to trade with dead or paywalled models, yet somehow Headline Arena and Qwen still managed to punk the DeepSeek camp on their way up.
